full_text_zh:
[P1] 瞒天过海

[P2] 穿着洁白的长袍，披着闪亮的铠甲，背后一把长弓，手握寒光四射的方天画戟，跨着白色的战马，飞驰而来……
这位威风凛凛的白袍将军是谁？
他就是唐朝名将薛仁贵。

[P3] 公元645年，唐太宗亲率大军，东征高句丽，任命张士贵做行军总管。那时，薛仁贵还只是张士贵手下的一名小兵，他也跟着大军出征了。

[P4] 三十万大军疾行了三个月，终于到达了大海边，而海对面就是高句丽。
三百艘战船停靠在岸，三十万大军披挂整齐，只等唐太宗一声令下，就可以攻向高句丽。

[P5] 巨大的海浪像千军万马猛扑过来，把战船击打得东摇西晃，唐太宗连站都站不稳，只觉得头晕眼花，好像一睁眼就要掉进大海里。

唐太宗南征北战，打过无数次胜仗，却从来没有打过海战，这还是他第一次看见大海。

晕

啪

唔

[P6] 唐太宗吓得赶紧下了船。他对行军总管张士贵说："海上风浪这么大，海里还不知道有什么妖魔鬼怪，万一船在海上出了事故，我们岂不是要全军覆没了么？还是想其他办法渡海吧！"可是茫茫的大海，三十万大军游过去是不可能的，建桥更是异想天开！改走陆路又太远，费时费力。到底该怎么办呢？

[P7] 于是，将领们都来劝唐太宗："陛下，我们大唐的战船又大又结实，我们的水军天天在海上操练，渡海一点儿危险都没有！"
"不行不行，不安全！"无论大家如何劝说，唐太宗就是连连摆手，不肯点头上船。

[P8] 就在这时，薛仁贵有了个主意。他对张士贵说：“陛下是因为害怕大海，才不敢上船，我有办法让陛下在不知不觉中平安渡海。”
张士贵真是着急呀！他愁得吃不下饭，睡不着觉，胡子都被他揪掉了一大把。

[P9] 第二天一大早，张士贵开眼笑地向唐太宗告：“陛下，有一位大富豪听说您要亲征高句丽，愿意为咱们的三十万兵马捐献粮草。”
唐太宗高兴得直拍桌子，连声叫道：“好！好！好！快带他来见我！”，

[P10] 只见这位富豪白发白须年纪大，可脸上一丝皱纹也没有，就像一位老神仙。他看见唐太宗就叩头："陛下亲征高句丽，一定能一帆风顺显威名，小老儿的粮草就堆放在海边的仓房里，装上船就能随大军一起出发了。"

[P11] 大家来到了富豪的仓房，捐献给三十万兵马的粮草都存放在这里，用布围得严严实实的。富豪请唐太宗来到最大的房间，只见四壁垂下长长的彩幔，看起来富丽堂皇，地上铺着厚厚的地毯，踩上去软绵绵的。

[P12] 桌子上已经摆满了美酒美食，富豪请唐太宗和将领们坐下来，为大家倒满了酒。将领们纷纷举杯，祝愿唐太宗征战胜利。一时间，乐声响起，美酒飘香，唐太宗高兴地大喝起来，一连好几天都没有回军营。

[P13] 这天，唐太宗正和将领们喝着酒，忽然看见桌子在跳，杯子和盘子“哗啦啦”摔在了地上，墙上的彩幔也被风吹得呼呼鼓起来，外面还响起了雷鸣一般的波涛声。起初，唐太宗以为是自己喝醉了，但仔细想想又觉得不对劲儿，于是，立刻命身边人掀开彩幔去查看。

[P14] 这一看，吓得唐太宗大喝一声："这是什么地方？" 只见彩幔之外，是无边无际的大海，海浪一个接一个翻滚着，咆哮着，好像要把大船撕成碎片。他哪里是在一个华丽舒适的房间里，分明是在一艘又高又大的战船上！

[P15] 老富豪摘下白发、白胡须，露出了真面目，原来他就是薛仁贵！唐太宗一看自己已经平安渡海，威名也没有受损，便哈哈大笑，饶恕了他们，还连连称赞他们的计策妙。
张士贵连忙上前回答说：‘陛下，我们现在正航行在大海上，借着风力，顺流而下，马上就要到高句丽了。’这时，那位老富豪也在唐太宗面前跪了下来：‘我们瞒着陛下渡了海，还请陛下恕罪！’

[P16] 薛仁贵用布作遮挡，让唐太宗在不知不觉中渡过了大海，到达了高句丽。因为在古时候，皇帝被称为“天子”，所以像这样伪装布局，偷偷采取行动的计策，就叫“瞒天过海”。
在征战高句丽的战场上，薛仁贵一身白袍，英勇无敌。唐太宗高兴地说：“得到辽东并不是最让我高兴的，我最高兴的是得到了薛仁贵这员猛将呀！”从此之后，人们就尊称薛仁贵为“白袍将军”。
full_text_en:
[P1] Steal the Sky to Cross the Sea

[P2] Wearing a pure white robe, clad in shiny armor, with a longbow on his back, holding a gleaming Fangtian Huaji, riding a white warhorse, he gallops forward...
Who is this magnificent general in white? 
He is Xue Ren Gui, a famous general of the Tang Dynasty.

[P3] In 645 AD, Emperor Taizong of Tang personally led a large army to campaign against Goguryeo, appointing Zhang Shigui as the commander-in-chief. At that time, Xue Ren Gui was just a common soldier under Zhang Shigui's command, and he also joined the army on this campaign.

[P4] The thirty万 army marched for three months and finally reached the seaside, with Goguryeo lying across the sea.
Three hundred warships were docked at the shore, and the thirty万 army was fully equipped and ready, waiting only for Emperor Taizong's command to attack Goguryeo.

[P5] Huge waves crashed over the ship like a thousand armies, making the warship rock violently. Emperor Taizong couldn't even stand steady, feeling dizzy and nauseous, as if he would fall into the sea at any moment.

Emperor Taizong had fought countless battles and won many victories, but he had never fought a naval battle before. This was his first time seeing the sea.

Dizzy

Thud

Ugh

[P6] Emperor Taizong was so frightened that he quickly got off the ship. He said to Zhang Shigui, the commander-in-chief: "The waves at sea are so fierce, and who knows what demons or monsters are lurking beneath? If the ship were to have an accident at sea, wouldn't our entire army be destroyed? We must think of another way to cross the sea!" But the vast ocean made it impossible for the 300,000-strong army to swim across. Building a bridge was pure fantasy! Taking the land route was too far and would take too much time and effort. What should they do?

[P7] Then, the generals came to persuade Emperor Taizong: "Your Majesty, our Tang warships are large and sturdy, and our navy trains at sea every day—there's absolutely no danger in crossing!"
"No, no, it's not safe!" No matter how much they tried to persuade him, Emperor Taizong kept waving his hands, refusing to agree to board the ship.

[P8] At this moment, Xue Ren Gui had an idea. He told Zhang Shigui, "Your Majesty is afraid of the sea, which is why he dares not board the ship. I have a way to let Your Majesty cross the sea safely without even realizing it." 
Zhang Shigui was truly anxious! He was so worried that he couldn't eat, couldn't sleep, and even pulled out a big clump of his beard.

[P9] The next morning, Zhang Shigui cheerfully reported to Emperor Taizong: "Your Majesty, a wealthy man has heard that you are personally leading the campaign against Goguryeo and is willing to donate provisions for our thirty thousand troops." 
Emperor Taizong was delighted, pounding the table and exclaiming: "Good! Good! Good! Bring him to me at once!"

[P10] Here is a wealthy man with white hair and a white beard, yet his face has not a single wrinkle, like an old immortal. He bows to Emperor Taizong: "Your Majesty, leading the campaign against Goguryeo, will surely sail smoothly and gain great fame. My grain and fodder are already piled up in the warehouses by the sea; they can be loaded onto ships and set off with the army at once."

[P11] Everyone arrived at the wealthy man's warehouse, where the grain and fodder donated for the thirty thousand troops were stored, tightly covered with cloth. The wealthy man invited Emperor Taizong to the largest room, where long colorful drapes hung from the four walls, making it look magnificent and luxurious. Thick carpets were laid on the floor, soft and cushiony underfoot.

[P12] The table was already filled with fine wine and delicious food. The wealthy man invited Emperor Taizong and the generals to sit down and poured wine for everyone. The generals raised their cups one after another, wishing Emperor Taizong victory in battle. In no time, music rang out, the aroma of wine filled the air, and Emperor Taizong drank heartily, not returning to camp for several days in a row.

[P13] That day, Emperor Taizong was drinking wine with his generals when suddenly he saw the table jumping, cups and plates crashing to the ground with a 'clatter', the colorful drapes on the wall flapping wildly in the wind, and a thunderous roar of waves outside. At first, Emperor Taizong thought he was drunk, but after thinking carefully, he felt something was wrong. So, he immediately ordered someone nearby to lift the drapes and investigate.

[P14] At this sight, Emperor Taizong cried out in shock: "Where is this place?" Beyond the colorful curtains, he saw an endless sea, with waves rolling one after another, roaring fiercely, as if about to tear the great ship into pieces. Where was he? Not in a luxurious and comfortable room, but clearly on a tall and massive warship!

[P15] The wealthy old man took off his white hair and white beard, revealing his true identity—he was Xue Ren Gui! Emperor Taizong saw that he had safely crossed the sea and his reputation remained unharmed, so he burst into laughter, forgave them, and praised their clever plan.
Zhang Shigui hurriedly replied: 'Your Majesty, we are now sailing on the sea, riding the wind and flowing downstream, and we will soon reach Goguryeo.' At that moment, the wealthy old man also knelt before Emperor Taizong: 'We secretly crossed the sea without Your Majesty's knowledge; we beg for your forgiveness!'

[P16] Xue Ren Gui used cloth to cover the scene, allowing Emperor Taizong to cross the sea unnoticed and reach Goguryeo. In ancient times, the emperor was called the 'Son of Heaven,' so a strategy like this, involving deception and covert action, was called 'Deceiving Heaven to Cross the Sea.'
On the battlefield against Goguryeo, Xue Ren Gui, dressed in white armor, was brave and invincible. Emperor Taizong happily said, 'Getting Liaodong is not what makes me happiest; what makes me happiest is getting the brave general Xue Ren Gui!' From then on, people respectfully called Xue Ren Gui the 'White Armor General.'
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页标题为“瞒天过海”，配有一名身穿铠甲、手持长矛的武将插图，背景简洁，无其他文字或对话。
[P2] 本页描绘了一位身穿白袍铠甲、骑着白马、手持方天画戟的将军形象，并通过文字介绍他是唐朝名将薛仁贵。
[P3] 本页描绘了公元645年唐太宗东征高句丽的场景，薛仁贵作为张士贵手下的一名小兵随军出征。
[P4] 唐军三十万大军历经三个月行军抵达海边，三百艘战船停靠岸边，军队整装待发，准备在唐太宗下令后进攻高句丽。
[P5] 唐太宗首次出海作战，遭遇巨浪，战船颠簸，他感到头晕目眩，难以站稳，画面表现了他初次面对大海的不适与惊慌。
[P6] 唐太宗因海上风浪过大而惊恐下船，向行军总管张士贵表达对渡海作战的担忧，认为船只可能出事导致全军覆没，但又苦于无法游渡、建桥或走陆路，陷入进退两难的困境。
[P7] 将领们劝说唐太宗登船渡海，强调战船坚固、水军训练有素，但唐太宗因害怕风浪而坚决拒绝上船。
[P8] 薛仁贵向张士贵提出一个让唐太宗在不知不觉中渡海的主意，而张士贵因皇帝不肯登船而焦急万分，愁得吃不下饭、睡不着觉。
[P9] 张士贵向唐太宗报告有一位富豪愿为征讨高句丽的三十万大军捐献粮草，唐太宗听后非常高兴，立即下令召见这位富豪。
[P10] 画面描绘了一位白发白须、面容年轻的富豪向唐太宗叩头进献粮草，表示其粮草已备好，可随大军一同出征。
[P11] 唐太宗一行来到富豪的仓房，看到为三十万大军准备的粮草被严密存放，富豪带他进入装饰华丽的大房间，四壁垂着彩幔，地上铺着厚地毯，显得富丽堂皇。
[P12] 富豪设宴款待唐太宗与将领们，席间众人举杯祝酒，唐太宗心情愉悦，连日留宿于富豪府中未回军营。
[P13] 唐太宗与将领们在富豪府中饮酒时，突然遭遇剧烈晃动，桌椅倾倒、彩幔飘动、波涛声大作，他起初以为是醉酒，后觉异常，立即命人掀开彩幔查看。
[P14] 唐太宗掀开彩幔后，发现自己身处波涛汹涌的大海之上，正乘坐在一艘巨大的战船上，惊骇不已。
[P15] 老富豪摘下伪装露出真面目，原来是薛仁贵。唐太宗得知自己已平安渡海，大笑原谅众人并称赞计策巧妙。张士贵解释当前正航行海上，即将抵达高句丽，老富豪则跪地请罪。
[P16] 本页讲述了薛仁贵用‘瞒天过海’之计帮助唐太宗渡海抵达高句丽，并在战场上英勇作战，赢得唐太宗赞赏，从此被尊称为‘白袍将军’。
